topic: 现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析与综合运用 (Present Perfect vs. Simple Past Tense)
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来攻克英语语法中的一大核心难点——现在完成时（have/has + 动词过去分词）与一般过去时（动词过去式）的辨析。简单来说，一般过去时关注的是“过去某个确切时间发生的事”，与现在没有联系，常带 explicit past time words（如 yesterday, ago, last week, in 2020）；而现在完成时则强调“过去的动作对现在造成的影响或结果”，或者“从过去持续到现在的经历”，通常不与具体的过去确定时间连用。例句 1: I lost my keys yesterday.（昨天丢了钥匙，只说明过去发生的事情）；例句 2: I have lost my keys, so I can't open the door now.（钥匙丢了，强调对现在造成的结果：进不去门）。

questions.question: She _____ her homework already, so she can go out to play now.
questions.explanation: 句中有标志词 already（已经），且强调作业完成对现在产生的影响（现在可以出去玩了），故用现在完成时 has finished。

questions.question: We _____ to the science museum three days ago.
questions.explanation: 句末有明确的过去时间状语 three days ago（三天前），表示纯粹的过去动作，故用一般过去时 went。

questions.question: How long _____ you _____ your pet dog? - For about two years.
questions.explanation: 由答语 For about two years 可知，此处询问从过去持续到现在的状态/拥有关系，应用现在完成时 have had（have 是助动词，had 是 have 的过去分词）。

questions.question: Tom is not at home. He _____ to the local library.
questions.explanation: have/has gone to 意为“去了某地（还没回来）”；have/has been to 意为“去过某地（已经回来）”。汤姆现在不在家，说明他去了图书馆还没回来，用 has gone。

questions.question: My aunt _____ in London since 2018.
questions.explanation: since + 过去具体年份是现在完成时的典型标志词，表示动作从 2018 年一直持续到现在，故选 has lived。

questions.question: Look! Someone _____ the window. It's so cold in the classroom!
questions.explanation: Look! 提示注意现在的状况，打破窗户的动作发生在过去，但对现在造成了“教室很冷”的结果，符合现在完成时的用法，选 has broken。

questions.question: Mr. Brown _____ English in our school last year.
questions.explanation: last year 是明确的过去时间状语，谓语动词需用一般过去式 taught。

questions.question: I _____ never _____ such a delicious strawberry cake before!
questions.explanation: before（以前）与 never 连用，常表达截至目前为止的个人经历，应用现在完成时 have tasted。

questions.question: When _____ you _____ this new bicycle?
questions.explanation: When 询问具体购买的时间点，关注的是过去发生的时间，不能与现在完成时连用，必须用一般过去时 did buy。

questions.question: They _____ the project yet. They still need a few more days.
questions.explanation: yet 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句末尾，表示“到目前为止尚未...”，主语为 They，故用 haven't finished。

questions.question: Lucy _____ to Japan twice. She loves the culture there.
questions.explanation: 表达“去过某地若干次”用 have/has been to，这里主语是 Lucy，表示去过日本两次，选 has been。

questions.question: Mozart _____ hundreds of beautiful pieces of music during his life.
questions.explanation: 莫扎特是历史人物，其创作音乐发生在过去且已完全结束，无法对现在产生持续的创作状态，应用一般过去时 wrote。

questions.question: I'm sorry, I can't play basketball with you because I _____ my ankle.
questions.explanation: 脚踝扭伤发生在过去，但造成了现在“不能打篮球”的结果，符合现在完成时，选 have hurt。

questions.question: _____ you ever _____ a camel in the desert?
questions.explanation: ever 表示“曾经”，用于询问截至目前的经历，用现在完成时 Have + 主语 + 过去分词 (ridden)。

questions.question: He _____ his keys ten minutes ago, but luckily he found them under the sofa.
questions.explanation: 句中有明确的过去时间标记 ten minutes ago，动作发生在过去，用一般过去时 lost。

questions.question: We _____ each other since we were in primary school.
questions.explanation: since 从句（since we were...）表示从过去某时刻开始，主句动词需用现在完成时 have known。

questions.question: Max _____ his grandparents in Canada last summer.
questions.explanation: last summer（去年夏天）属于过去的明确具体时间，谓语用一般过去式 visited。

questions.question: Be quiet! The baby _____ asleep just now.
questions.explanation: just now 意为“刚才”，是典型的一般过去时标志词，动词 fall 需用过去式 fell。

questions.question: My father _____ smoking for five years. He feels much healthier now.
questions.explanation: for five years 搭配从过去持续到现在的戒烟动作，且强调现在身体更健康，用现在完成时 has given up。

questions.question:
- Where is Sarah?
- She _____ to the supermarket to buy some fruits.
questions.explanation: 问句询问“人在哪里”，答句表示“她去超市了（还没回来）”，需用 has gone。

questions.question: Shakespeare _____ many world-famous plays in the 16th and 17th centuries.
questions.explanation: 句中提及 16、17 世纪这一过去的明确历史时期，作者莎士比亚已故，故用一般过去时 wrote。

questions.question: I _____ this movie last night with my parents.
questions.explanation: last night（昨晚）是过去的时间点，用一般过去时 watched。

questions.question:
- _____ you _____ your lunch yet?
- Yes, I have.
questions.explanation: 末尾标志词 yet 结合答句 Yes, I have，判定问句为现在完成时 Have you eaten...?

questions.question: How many English storybooks _____ you _____ this term?
questions.explanation: this term（本学期）包含现在在内，强调到目前为止读书的数量统计，应用现在完成时 have read。

questions.question: My brother _____ his leg yesterday while playing football.
questions.explanation: yesterday（昨天）是具体过去时间，谓语动词用 break 的过去式 broke。

questions.question: Hurry up! The train _____ just _____. We missed it!
questions.explanation: just（刚刚）常放在 have/has 与过去分词之间，强调“火车刚刚离开”对现在造成的结果（我们赶不上了），用 has left。

questions.question: We _____ in this community for ten years, and we still live here now.
questions.explanation: 后半句 still live here now 表明居住动作从过去一直持续到现在，故 for ten years 需搭配现在完成时 have lived。

questions.question: What time _____ the concert _____ yesterday evening?
questions.explanation: What time 询问过去确切时间点，且带有 yesterday evening 标志词，必须使用一般过去时 did start。

questions.question: I can't find my passport! _____ you _____ it anywhere?
questions.explanation: 前半句“找不到护照”是现在的困境，询问对方“截至目前是否看到过”，强调对现在的影响，用 Have you seen...?

questions.question: My uncle _____ to Australia in 2022 and returned to China last month.
questions.explanation: in 2022 是明确的过去年份，后面的 returned 也是一般过去式，因此空格处需填一般过去式 went。
